assumptions.statement: Concurrent impact channels combine by max, not sum.
Nodes recover linearly over recovery_time_minutes after incident end.
Edge impact scales linearly with criticality_weight and capacity_fraction.
Deterministic model uses the median of each edge's declared lag interval.
Capacity-flow model treats the capability as a static flow network at peak stress; a business is not literally a flow network.
